images.filename: Battery Jasper, Fort Moultrie, Poe Avenue, Sullivan’s Island, SC (50621926153).jpg
images.caption: Built in 1898 during the Spanish-American War to fend off possible attack of Charleston by the Spanish naval force, and remained in operation until World War II, when it was decommissioned following the installation of more modern fortifications nearby.

images.filename: Boathouse, U.S. Coast Guard Station, U.S. Coast Guard Historic District, Sullivan’s Island, SC (50621949988).jpg
images.caption: Originally built in 1891, the old Coast Guard Station has several buildings dating to 1891, 1898, and 1938, which were built during its period of operation as an active United States Coast Guard Station.  Since closed, the station has been repurposed by the National Park Service for their operations at Fort Sumter and Fort Moultrie National Historic Park.
images.alt: Originally built in 1891, the old Coast Guard Station has several buildings dating to 1891, 1898, and 1938, which were built during its period of operation as an active United States Coast Guard Station.
